Job Details

Job Details

Join a manufacturing team where your data expertise will help drive smarter decisions, stronger operations, and continuous improvement. In this permanent IT role, you will transform manufacturing and business data into actionable insights, build reporting solutions, and support the systems that keep production moving.

You will partner with stakeholders across production, supply chain, inventory, finance, and IT to improve data visibility, streamline reporting, and uncover opportunities to enhance performance.

Responsibilities

Develop, maintain, and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and data extracts to support reporting and analysis.

Design and deliver dashboards that make manufacturing KPIs, trends, and operational performance easy to understand.

Develop SSRS reports, including parameter-driven and scheduled reports, to meet business requirements.

Analyze data from Syteline ERP and related systems to support production planning, inventory management, purchasing, costing, and financial reporting.

Develop and maintain VB.NET applications and VBA automation to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve reporting efficiency.

Collaborate with business users to gather requirements and translate operational challenges into practical technical solutions.

Validate data accuracy, investigate discrepancies, and improve consistency across reports and dashboards.

Troubleshoot reporting and application issues, optimize performance, and document solutions.

Support testing, deployment, and adoption of reporting enhancements and ERP-related changes.

Qualifications

5+ years of relevant experience in data analysis, IT reporting, business intelligence, or a similar role, with experience supporting manufacturing operations.

Strong hands-on experience with SQL, including complex queries, stored procedures, and performance optimization.

Proven ability to build dashboards using business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent platforms.

Experience developing and maintaining SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) reports or equivalent enterprise reporting solutions.

Working knowledge of Syteline ERP, also known as Infor CloudSuite Industrial, or an equivalent manufacturing ERP system.

Practical development experience with VB.NET and VBA, or equivalent programming and automation technologies.

Understanding of manufacturing processes and data, including production, inventory, supply chain, and costing.

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with close attention to data quality.

Ability to communicate technical information clearly and collaborate with both technical teams and business stakeholders.

Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver reliable solutions in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

A degree in information technology, computer science, data analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Engineering Laboratory Technician, College of Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics
jobs.description:
Job Overview

The Laboratory Technician I provides hands-on instructional laboratory and technical support mainly for the Industrial and Systems Engineering (ISE) and Bioengineering (BIOE) programs in CSTEM and may help with other engineering programs as needed. Working with faculty, program leads, and campus service units, the technician prepares, commissions, operates, maintains, and documents instructional equipment and computing environments; supports safe and effective laboratory demonstrations, design projects, and student use; and maintains equipment readiness.

For ISE, the role supports computer-aided design, human factors and ergonomics, discrete-event systems simulation, and capstone prototyping. For Bioengineering, it supports bioinstrumentation, physiological measurement, biomedical imaging, fluid mechanics and transport, biomechanics, bioreactor-based instruction, and medical-device design. Laboratory Technician I operates under the lead direction of the lead engineering technician, ISE/BIOE program directors and the direct supervision of the Associate Dean. The technician will receive the required instructions for lab preparations from the faculty with the approval of the respective program directors. The performance will be evaluated regularly by the Associate Dean, with input from faculty members to ensure their needs are met, and tasks are completed satisfactorily.

Position Summary

Engineering Laboratory Technician (Instructional Support Technician I)

This is a full-time, non-exempt position, which will lead toward permanent status following the successful completion of a probationary period.

For a complete list of responsibilities and required qualifications, please review the position description linked at the top of the page.

jobs.description:
Werfen is a growing, family-owned, innovative company founded in 1966 in Barcelona, Spain. We are a worldwide leader in specialized diagnostics in the areas of Hemostasis, Acute Care Diagnostics, Transfusion, Autoimmunity, and Transplant. Through our Original Equipment Manufacturing (OEM) business line, we research, develop, and manufacture customized assays and biomaterials. We operate directly in 30 countries, and in more than 100 territories through distributors. Our Headquarters and Technology Centers are located in the US and Europe, and our workforce is more than 7,000 strong.

Our success comes from a specific focus in these rapidly evolving diagnostic areas, our commitment to customers, and our dedication to innovation and quality. We’re passionate about providing healthcare professionals the most valuable and complete solutions to improve hospital efficiency and enhance patient care.

Overview

Werfen Autoimmunity Manufacturing Associates play a critical role in the manufacturing and/or testing of a variety of Autoimmune-related diagnostics products. This position is responsible for the manufacture and/or testing of components of diagnostic kits used by clinicians around the world for the diagnosis of autoimmune disorders. Our Manufacturing Associates work in a highly specialized team environment, using advanced automated equipment and instrumentation to manufacture and test in-process components and raw materials. Employees help ensure producquality by participating in troubleshooting and developing quality improvements within our multiple value streams. Work is performed under department supervision and in accordance with the company’s Quality Management System.

The current opening is working in the IFA team to manufacture IFA slides, controls, bulks and all other related components.

Responsibilities

Key Accountabilities

Under supervision follows standard operating procedures, work instructions, and other procedures for routine manufacturing and/or testing.
Participates in the bulking and/or evaluation of in-process components and reagents according to procedures.
Packages, fills, and operates equipment to ensure in-process components are completed (if applicable).
Maintains detailed Device History Records and/or any other associated documentation for all manufacturing activities.
Operates and cleans equipment and instrumentation for routine manufacturing and/or testing.
Assists with evaluations of raw materials (if applicable).
Follows established safety and environmental procedures.
Maintains lab and work area in a clean and orderly manner.
Complies with applicable Werfen standard operating procedures (SOPs), ISO, FDA and other Quality System regulations, as well as applicable Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), Human Resources and other regulatory and company policies.
Reflects Werfen Values in the quality of work and in working relationships.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Networking/Key relationships

Other Manufacturing teams
Operations teams, including Equipment Engineering, Facilities & Environmental Health & Safety (EHS)
Shared Services teams, including Filling and Packaging
Product Testing team
Manufacturing Technical Service
Global Systems Support

Qualifications

Minimum Knowledge & Experience for the position

Education: Bachelor’s degree in biologicial or related sciences required. Certificate program or A.S. degree with 3-4 years relevant experience in a life sciences laboratory may be substitued for a degree.

Experience: 0-1 years of life sciences laboratory experience required. Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment in the healthcare sector strongly preferred.

Management has the discretion of substituting relevant work experience for a degree and/or making exceptions to the years of experience requirement.

Basic understanding of basic laboratory practices and procedures.
Basic understanding of Good Manufacturing Practices.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Attentiveness to details to spot flaws in products or problems with equipment to prevent quality issues.
Problem-solving ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
Time management skills to meet production goals without compromising quality.

jobs.title: Incoming Quality Control Technician
jobs.description:
Ultimate Staffing
is hiring for IQC Technicians to work a 100% onsite at our customer's site located in San Jose CA.
Shift 1: Monday-Friday, 9:00 A.M.-5:30 P.M.
6 Month Assignment
Position Summary

We are seeking a diligent and detail-oriented Incoming Quality Control Technician to support incoming material inspection, microscopy-based evaluation, process development, quality control, and failure analysis activities. This technician will perform visual and dimensional inspections of purchased parts, materials, assemblies, and samples to verify conformance to approved drawings, specifications, procedures, and inspection plans before release for production use. The ideal candidate works safely and independently, maintains accurate records, communicates clearly, and consistently delivers reliable results in a high-volume technical environment.
Responsibilities

· Perform incoming visual and dimensional inspections of purchased parts, materials, assemblies, and samples in accordance with approved procedures, specifications, drawings, and inspection plans.
· Operate optical microscopy and standard metrology equipment such as calipers, micrometers, height gauges, bore gauges, dial indicators, surface plates, and optical comparators, as trained and qualified.
· Conduct First Article or new-part inspections under established procedures and document results for technical review.
· Prepare samples and inspection fixtures; enter, review, and upload inspection data, images, and supporting documentation into approved quality, laboratory, or ERP systems.
· Record inspection results, maintain inspection history files, and support material release or hold transactions according to established procedures and authorization levels.
· Identify nonconforming material, preserve traceability, prevent mix-ups or damage, and initiate or support nonconformance documentation for technical disposition.
· Monitor and record key process or test parameters and apply sound troubleshooting and critical-thinking skills to deliver repeatable, reliable results.
· Communicate inspection findings to engineers, quality partners, and operations personnel.
· Maintain clear shift passdowns, laboratory notebooks, equipment logs, calibration-status awareness, and organized work areas.
· Follow all safety, chemical handling, hazardous waste, contamination-control, and material-handling procedures.
· Support changing Manufacturing, R&D, and laboratory priorities while meeting quality, throughput, and turnaround expectations.
Minimum Requirements

· High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or technical certificate in engineering technology, metrology, manufacturing, materials science, laboratory science, or a related field preferred.
· At least 2 years of combined relevant education and hands-on experience in incoming inspection, quality control, metrology, manufacturing, microscopy, or an analytical laboratory environment.
· Experience reading technical drawings, specifications, tolerances, and inspection instructions.
· Experience with chemical handling, sample preparation, and hazardous waste disposal, with knowledge of safe laboratory practices.
· Ability to use computer-based quality systems, laboratory databases, ERP systems, and Microsoft Office applications for data entry and documentation.
· Ability to work in a glovebox, dry room, fume hood, laboratory, or manufacturing inspection area as required.
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

· Careful, consistent, and detail-oriented approach to inspection, sample handling, data entry, and documentation.
· Ability to follow controlled procedures and inspection plans while recognizing and escalating abnormal conditions.
· Strong organization, prioritization, and time-management skills in a high-volume environment with changing priorities.
· Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineering, quality, manufacturing, purchasing, and supplier-facing teams.
· Practical problem-solving skills and willingness to learn new inspection, microscopy, and metrology techniques.
· Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a collaborative team environment.
· Demonstrated reliability in meeting commitments, maintaining traceability, and protecting product quality.
· Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, initial training schedules, or overtime to cover business needs and shift gaps.
Physical Requirements

· Work may be performed in a laboratory, dry room, fume hood, glovebox, or manufacturing inspection area.
· Frequent use of fine motor skills and inspection equipment; ability to stand or sit for extended periods and perform reaching and twisting motions with the hands and arms.
· Ability to safely lift and move items weighing up to 25 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.
· Ability to use required personal protective equipment and follow site-specific environmental, health, and safety requirements.
Preferred Qualifications

· Experience in a Li-ion battery, medical device, semiconductor, precision manufacturing, or analytical test laboratory environment.

· Experience with analytical methods or sample-preparation techniques such as ion milling, XCT, XRD, ICP, XPS, or titration.
· Experience preparing samples in an inert environment, including glovebox operation and dry rooms.

QC Technician

Description

Position Title

Quality Control ("QC") Technician

Position Summary

A Quality Control Technician's (QC Tech) principal responsibility is to evaluate Digital Cinema Packages (DCPs).

This is a union-based position. It is also 100% onsite at our Burbank and Hollywood office locations.

Main Duties

In order to prepare for quality control screenings, the QC Technician ensures that the screening environment complies with required security protocols and ensures proper setup of the screening environment by performing technical procedures, play back DCPs to determine whether they pass or fail acceptable delivery requirements, and provides an administrative report of their findings to all applicable parties. These screenings are performed either internally or with clients, who may include but are not limited to: motion picture studio executives, creatives, technicians, and other studio representatives.

Key Responsibilities

Conducting Audio/Video/subtitle evaluations for all content
Checking audio sync, subtitle/caption sync and positioning
Following proper escalation of room and equipment issue
Verifying KDM (Key Delivery Message) validity against the DCP to be evaluated
Verifying DCP metadata against work order requirements
D-Cinema setup of playback server, projector, audio configuration and 3D system
External captioning device setup
Ensuring screening environment complies with required security protocols
Logging data regarding QC evaluations
Notification of QC flagged items
Completing tasks in database

Qualifications

3-5 years quality control experience in the entertainment industry
Working knowledge of both OSX and Windows and a fundamental understanding of audio, video, and film
Must be organized, diligent, and detail-oriented and possess strong written and verbal communication skills
Duties require a very focused and detailed attention to audio, video, and film impairments and artifacts
Capable of working in a fast-paced environment with hard deadlines
Ability to make frequent "subjective" decisions as part of their daily function to determine the "severity rating" for quality defects, determining which defects are acceptable, etc.
Flexibility to work extended hours to meet project deadlines

jobs.description:
Summary

SUMMARY:
Under direction of the Manager of Grants & Special Projects, the Clinical Research Associate coordinates all aspects of clinical trials within the assigned unit.at the Adult Immunology Clinic, Highland Campus. In consultation with providers and other clinical personnel, is responsible for selecting, implementing and monitoring clinical trials, educating, and when appropriate, enrolling patients into the various programs. Performs related duties as required.

DUTIES & ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
NOTE: The following are the duties performed by employees in this classification. However, employees may perform other related duties at an equivalent level. Not all duties listed are necessarily performed by each individual in the classification.

CLINICAL TRIALS: Responsible for assisting in the selection and administration of appropriate clinical research trials by reviewing studies, adhering to federal regulations and ICH Guidelines, with an emphasis on good clinical practice and clinical Safety Data Management. Administers informed consent, enrollment of participants into clinical trials.

INSTITUTIONAL REVIEW BOARD (IRB): Acts as departmental representative at Institutional Review Board’s Human Subject Committee meetings. Presents all new research projects to the committee. Modifies, renews and closes out all appropriate research projects. Reports all serious adverse events and protocol violations. Submits drug and/or device safety reports to the IRB.

REGULATORY: Organizes research team and meets as needed. Maintains current CVs and licenses for all study investigators. Updates regulatory binders for each research study. Provides central protocol and drug information to departments. Educates hospital personnel regarding protocols and screening requirements. Reports serious adverse events to study sponsor and FDA, when appropriate. Ensures compliance with all federal and state laws regarding research and confidentiality. In collaboration with nursing staff, assures that operations are in compliance with external guidelines, statutory and accreditation parameters including JCAHO, Title 22, HCFA, OSHA, and other laws/regulations

PRESENTATION AND PUBLICATIONS: Assists investigators in the preparation of manuscripts and the design of posters and oral presentations for annual conventions, conferences and trainings, when appropriate. Performs searches through existing medical literature.

ADMINISTRATIVE/FISCAL: Organizes research team (nurses, co-investigators) and meets with team, as needed. Maintains current CVs and licenses for all sub investigators and binders for each protocol. Acts as the point person for budgetary and administrative issues. When appropriate, prepares and negotiates study budget. Monitors and accounts for all study related income and expenses. Requests and administers patient compensation and petty cash. Provides scheduled accounting of research funds to department directors. Interacts with AHS staff in a professional and courteous manner. Supervises research personnel to ensure compliance with protocols. Obtains, interview, and directly supervise research department volunteers and medical students on research elective rotations.

Minimum Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s Degree (180 quarter units or 120 semester units) with major coursework in health and human sciences, biology or a field related to the work. (Additional experience as outlined below may be substituted for the education on a year-to-year basis.)

Minimum Experience: Possess experience and expertise in medical research. Experience and expertise can be gained by “hands-on experience” in a medical or scientific setting, as a graduate or medical student or other medically trained individual. Typically equal to the equivalent of two years of full-time experience as a Clinical Research Associate or equivalent level position at a public hospital, medical center or HMO.

Required Licenses/Certifications: BLS - Basic Life Support Certification issued by AHA-American Heart Association.

Pay Range: $52.21 - $63.48 / Hour

The pay range for this position reflects the base pay scale for the role at Alameda Health System. Final compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to a candidate’s experience, education, skills, licensure and certifications, departmental equity, applicable collective bargaining agreements, and the operational needs of the organization. UC San Diego values and welcomes people from all backgrounds. If you are interested in being part of our team, possess the needed licensure and certifications, and feel that you have most of the qualifications and/or transferable skills for a job opening, we strongly encourage you to apply.

UCSD Layoff from Career Appointment : Apply by 11/20/2026 for consideration with preference for rehire. All layoff applicants should contact their Employment Advisor.

Reassignment Applicants : Eligible Reassignment clients should contact their Disability Counselor for assistance.

Description

The Prather Research Lab at Scripps Institution of Oceanography is seeking a motivated Laboratory Research Assistant to support ongoing research into aerosol production, composition, and the airborne transmission of microbial pathogens. This position plays a critical role in advancing two major interdisciplinary research initiatives: CAICE, which investigates how aerosol particles influence climate, air quality, and atmospheric chemistry, and the Airborne Institute, which studies the intersection of climate change and airborne disease transmission while developing practical solutions to improve air quality indoors and outdoors.

The Lab Assistant will work at the intersection of atmospheric chemistry, environmental microbiology, and field science, contributing to a research program that uses both laboratory-based aerosol generation systems (including novel "ocean-atmosphere" simulation chambers) and real-world field sampling to understand how aerosols form, travel, and impact human health and the environment.

Who We Are

Founded in 1965, UC Irvine
is a member of the prestigious Association of American Universities and is ranked among the nation’s top 10 public universities by U.S. News & World Report. It’s located in one of the world’s safest and most economically vibrant communities and is Orange County’s second-largest employer, contributing $7 billion annually to the local economy and $8 billion statewide.

To learn more about UC Irvine, visit www.uci.edu.

Our lab is based in both the UCI School of Medicine and its Department of Emergency Medicine. Our work bridges together researchers from across the U.S. as well as across University of California campuses to study traffic and transportation safety, motor vehicle driver behavior, socioecological factors that influence safe/risky driving behaviors, and related prevention policy. While our work is focused on traffic and road safety, most of our day-to-day work is focused on individual/population health, medicine, and primary as well as secondary prevention of motor vehicle crash injury.

UCI's Department of Emergency Medicine is committed to advancing clinical care, education and research to help patients with diverse emergency conditions. We offer patient-centered care, apply cutting edge skills to combat serious illness and injury. In addition, our physicians conduct innovative research aimed at preventing injury and disease.

Your Role on the Team

Under the direction of the Principal Investigator, the Staff Research Associate (SRA) will be responsible for day-to-day operations of assigned data analysis for research projects and writing briefs and manuscripts related to research. The candidate will need to have experience of epidemiology and data science using statistical and analytical techniques/computer science and can ensure timelines are met. The person will conduct statistical analyses on the current and future research projects, and write up the research results into manuscripts, briefs, and grant applications. The candidate will work with lab staff and students to further the research goals of the lab.

The ideal candidate will be extremely motivated, highly organized, and highly detail oriented. Must have a minimum of a bachelor’s degree and greater than 3 years of epidemiology and data science research and/or work experience. Demonstrated knowledge and skill in current and emerging biostatistical and data science analytical techniques.

To successfully address these tasks on time, the SRA must have a broad set of intelligence, be extremely diligent and task-oriented, and an efficient worker. Excellent communication and writing skills are required.

The SRA will be supervised by the Principal Investigator, with the ultimate goal of progressive independence once the SRA has demonstrated the ability to carry out the PI and project related plans.

Required

Proficiency in hypothesis testing, including no mistakes in use of t-tests, regressions, ANOVA, mixed effects modeling, chi-square, and other common tests.
Proficiency in writing the methods and results sections of peer-reviewed scientific manuscripts, including using proper grammar and syntax.
Proficiency in artificial intelligence modeling
Proficiency in cleaning and organizing data
Ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships

Ability to communicate effectively about task deadlines and ability to complete on time while managing competing demands / assignments / deadlines. Excellent organizational skills to maintain accurate records and coordinate other tasks as required
Experience working and communicating with sensitive populations, such as adolescents, alcohol/substance use populations

Demonstrated ability to develop, organize, track projects, and coordinate complex activities requiring a high level of accuracy and meticulous attention to detail
Knowledge and proficiency of R, Python, SAS, Stata, SurveyMonkey, Qualtrics, RED Cap, Wordpress, Dashboard, Canva, Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Ability to work independently and report to Principal Investigator on a regular basis and in a timely manner within a deadline-driven structure
Proficiency in safe management and storage or data, including HIPAA. Familiarity with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA) to ensure confidentiality, privacy, and security of patient information

Demonstrated ability to manage a moderate volume of work efficiently and meet deadlines with frequent interruptions and changing priorities

Demonstrated ability to train, supervise, and monitor progress/evaluate the associated personnel/students in research procedures and data collection
Ability to be punctual and maintain a satisfactory attendance record

Job Overview

The Senior Manager of Data Science is a hands-on role at the intersection of Data Science, Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, and Clinical Data Management. The ideal candidate combines strong programming and technical development skills with an understanding of clinical studies and the ability to build practical solutions that improve how teams access, analyze, visualize, and work with clinical data.

This position will support ongoing studies while also helping build the technical infrastructure, automation, and reusable tools that enable a growing Biometrics organization to work more efficiently. Additionally, this position will play an important role in establishing modern development standards (version control, code review, testing, and automation) and modernizing clinical analytics with open-source tools.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Key Project Responsibilities:

Develop data science solutions and analytical tools to support clinical studies and broader Biometrics initiatives.
Design and build dashboards and interactive data visualizations (e.g., R Shiny) that enable effective clinical data review and decision-making.
Work with databases and clinical data sources to support data integration, access, analysis, and visualization.
Build and maintain automated workflows using GitHub and GitHub Actions, including automated quality checks, testing, code review, and deployment workflows for analytical applications and tools.
Partner closely with Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, Data Management, and other cross-functional stakeholders to understand study needs and develop effective technical solutions.
Apply R and SAS to clinical data and analytical challenges, selecting the appropriate technology for each use case, and use Python when it provides the most effective solution.
Develop reusable tools, R packages, workflows, and infrastructure that can be leveraged by Statistical Programming, Biostatistics, Data Management, and other team members.

Initiative Responsibilities

Under the guidance of the Head of Clinical Data Analytics, identify opportunities to automate manual processes and introduce innovative technologies and more efficient ways of working.
Establish and promote effective Git/GitHub workflows, version control, and collaborative development practices, and mentor less experienced team members in adopting modern programming, automation, and application development practices.

Education

Qualifications and Preferred Skills

Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics/Biostatistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.

Experience And Skill Set

Minimum of 6 years of experience in data science, statistical programming, or clinical analytics in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO clinical trial environment.
Advanced R and SAS programming skills, with strong hands-on experience with Git and GitHub, including creating GitHub Actions to automate testing, validation, or other development workflows.
Working knowledge of Python, with the ability to apply it selectively when it is the appropriate solution, is desirable.
Familiarity with CDISC standards (SDTM, ADaM) and regulatory submission requirements.
Good knowledge of the drug development process, study design, statistical methodology, regulatory guidance, and medical terminology.
Experience developing analytical applications, dashboards, and data visualizations, including R Shiny.
Experience working with databases and integrating data into analytical workflows.
Strong understanding of software development and collaborative coding practices, such as code review, modular design, and documentation.
Results-oriented, with proven problem-solving skills and a strong interest in continued learning.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with cross-functional teams.
Experience building infrastructure, frameworks, or reusable tools that enable other programmers, statisticians, or data scientists to work more efficiently.
Adaptable and able to thrive in a fast-paced, startup environment while managing multiple priorities effectively.
Experience with regulatory audits and inspections (e.g., FDA, PMDA, NMPA, EMA) is a strong advantage.

Lead the deployment, and integration of EDA tools across multiple vendors, balancing productivity, quality, flexibility, and cost.

Required Qualifications

Deep understanding of the complete ASIC development lifecycle, from architecture and RTL through tapeout—enough to be a credible partner to every functional team.
Experience owning CAD and infrastructure across multiple successful SoC programs.
Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining an integrated RTL-to-GDS flow environment—tool and version management, foundry and IP collateral integration, and flow release and qualification across concurrent projects.
Strong understanding of engineering compute infrastructure: distributed scheduling (LSF, Slurm, or equivalent), storage systems, networking, cloud environments, and license management at scale.

jobs.title: Pathology Laboratory Assistant
jobs.description:
Job description

POSITION SUMMARY

Under the direction of Laboratory Leadership, the Pathology Laboratory Assistant plays a vital role on the front lines of patient diagnostics by receiving, accessioning, and preparing specimens for processing. Additional core duties include operating specialized laboratory and Whole-Slide Imaging (WSI) equipment, managing slide and paraffin block archives, onboarding and training incoming team members, and delivering responsive, professional support to internal and external stakeholders.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Specimen Processing and Digital Pathology Workflow

 Verifies patient demographics and clinical information across all requisitions and specimen containers to
ensure zero-defect accuracy.
 Performs accurate data entry of patient demographics, specimen sources, clinical history, and ordered tests into the Laboratory Information System (LIS) in accordance with established protocols.
 Scans requisitions and supporting clinical documentation, uploading files cleanly to patient records in the LIS and secure cloud-based storage drives.
 Flags specimens with missing information, labeling discrepancies, or compromised integrity; consults with Pathologists or Pathologists’ Assistants and proactively contacts submitting client offices to resolve issues.
 Prepares and affixes compliant barcode labels to specimen containers.
 Operates the histology cassette printer and prepares cassettes accurately for the grossing bench.
 Distributes processed samples and accompanying documentation seamlessly to appropriate laboratory
divisions (Histology, Grossing, Pathologists).
 Operates Whole-Slide Imaging (WSI) scanners and distributes high-resolution digital images to appropriate providers and pathologists.

Archive Management, Logistics and Laboratory Operations

 Updates and maintains strict chain-of-custody logs, documents discrepancies, and archives records in
designated cloud drives.
 Processes and prepares slides, paraffin blocks, and materials for internal workflows and external distribution (including partner facilities such as Dignity Health, outpatient providers, and UC Davis Pathology).
 Files and retrieves pathology slides and paraffin blocks systematically, fulfilling requests for additional levels, recuts, or special stains.
 Documents and safely disposes of tissue hold samples per established retention schedules.
 Coordinates, processes, and tracks specimen send-outs and pathology material returns.
 Maintains daily, weekly, and monthly environmental, equipment, and safety logs.
 Assists with client supply inventory management, stocking, and distribution.
 Works independently to troubleshoot routine workflow or equipment bottlenecks, escalating complex issues to Laboratory Leadership when appropriate.

Stakeholder Communication, Teamwork and Training

 Stakeholder Communication: Delivers clear, courteous, professional, and timely communication (via
telephone, email, and electronic portals) with co-workers, pathologists, clients, patients, and external vendors regarding result statuses, additional testing, and logistics.
 Culture and Collaboration: Maintains a positive, solutions-oriented attitude; actively fosters teamwork, cross-functional collaboration, and adaptability during workflow improvements and Lean initiatives.
 Onboarding and Training: Assists in training and mentoring new employees, per-diem staff, and laboratory interns on accessioning, WSI scanning, and laboratory safety protocols as required.
 Operational Flexibility: Performs other duties as assigned by Laboratory Leadership to support evolving
operational and patient care needs.

Collects blood specimens, as well as receives, handles and processes specimens for Laboratory testing. Collects blood specimens for a variety of Laboratory tests using age-appropriate techniques; handles/transports Lab specimens and provides post-phlebotomy care to patients. jobs.description:
Job Description

The Statistical Data Analyst conducts statistical research analyses by developing research protocols, compiling data, managing data bases, analyzing data using specialized statistical computer programs, and presenting research results in numerical and graphic formats. This position supports institutional research, student success analytics, college accountability, and institutional reporting within the Office of Decision Support. Responsibilities include statistical analysis, data integration and modeling, and development of dashboards and reports to support institutional planning and decision-making.

Duties include use of specific statistical analysis software such as SAS or SPSS and may include SQL or other programming. This position may act as a data consultant to several research studies.

Responsibilities

Develops analytical plans for institutional research projects by determining data requirements, identifying appropriate data sources, and selecting statistical methods and analytical procedures.
Conducts statistical analyses of institutional data using SAS, SQL, and other analytical tools. Examines student enrollment, progression, retention, graduation, and other institutional outcomes. Develops, evaluates, and refines statistical and predictive models in consultation with project leads.
Summarizes and communicates analytical results through graphs, tables, charts, and interactive Power Bl dashboards. Develops and maintains Power Bl and Excel reports, including supporting data models and calculations, and explains findings and limitations to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Designs recurring and ad hoc reports and analyses requested by administrators. Supports the College Accountability Framework, college scorecards, Accountability Plan, Performance-Based Funding metrics, and other institutional reporting needs, including comparisons with peer institutions.
Collaborates with team members and institutional partners to clarify research questions and reporting requirements, select appropriate statistical Designs, develops, and maintains analytical datasets, database tables, and views using SQL, SAS, and Microsoft SQL Server. Develops and automates extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes to integrate data from multiple sources and support analysis and reporting. Works with systems programmers and data owners as needed.
Validates data, programs, analyses, and reports for accuracy and consistency. Documents data sources, methodologies, business rules, and technical processes to support reproducibility and continuity.
Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

This position requires a Bachelor's degree in a field directly related to the research or data analysis responsibilities and a minimum of one year of research experience; or a Master's degree in one of the same fields. Progressively responsible work experience may substitute for the college on a year for year basis.

Degree Equivalency Clause: Four years of direct experience for a bachelor’s degree.

jobs.title: Computational Automation and Data Science Scientist
jobs.description:
Company Description

Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

Job Description

The Extreme Light, Matter, and Fusion Directorate (LMF), formerly the NIF & Photon Science Directorate, is seeking a Computational Automation and Data Science
Scientist to leverage AI to support the automation, optimization, and integration of manual computational procedures used in scientific research, engineering, and laboratory operations. The successful candidate will develop data-analysis algorithms, machine-learning applications, database interfaces, and automated workflows that improve efficiency, repeatability, and decision-making.

This position will work within an interdisciplinary research and development environment and collaborate with scientists, engineers, technicians, software developers, and industrial partners. The selected candidate will translate scientific and engineering requirements into computational tools, automate existing analysis processes, manage scientific data, and support assigned software, data, and computational capabilities.

In this role, you will

Review existing manual computational procedures and develop automated, scalable, and maintainable workflows under general direction. Work includes algorithms for data processing, feature extraction, classification, prediction, anomaly detection, and statistical analysis.
Apply established machine-learning methods to scientific, engineering, laboratory, or operational data, including designing, training, validating, and evaluating models using appropriate performance metrics.
Develop tools and scripts for data ingestion, cleaning, transformation, visualization, and analysis.
Interface with databases and data systems, including developing queries, data pipelines, schemas, and data-management solutions.
Integrate computational tools with laboratory instruments, engineering systems, software applications, and data repositories to create user-focused tools that improve the efficiency, consistency, and traceability of technical procedures.
Document, test, validate, and maintain automated workflows, analytical tools, and operating procedures, and prepare technical reports, experimental plans, and procedures.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Additional Job Responsibilities, At The SES.2 Level

Assess data quality, uncertainty, bias, reproducibility, and limitations of computational results. Develop methods for identifying trends, correlations, outliers, anomalies, and failure conditions in complex datasets using creative and innovative approaches; and recommend improvements to methods and processes.
Contribute and maintain procedures for assigned computational, software, and data-analysis capabilities, including support for machine-vision or image-analysis methods, exploring a variety of approaches within established methods and contributing to the advancement of existing techniques.
Prepare patents and peer-reviewed publications; and in open and classified environments, both internally and externally; provide informal guidance and mentoring to less-experienced personnel. Work independently with minimal direction while contributing effectively to multidisciplinary research and development teams.

Qualifications

Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship.
Bachelor of Science degree in computer science, data science, computational science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Experience developing computational tools, scripts, algorithms, or automated workflows, including experience with data analysis, data processing, statistical methods, or scientific computing.
Experience using machine-learning techniques for classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, prediction, or related applications.
Experience with one or more programming languages commonly used for data analysis and automation, such as Python, MATLAB, R, C++, or a comparable language.
Familiarity with databases, data structures, data modeling, SQL, application programming interfaces, or data-management systems.
Sufficient verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively in a team environment, present and explain technical information, and learn and apply new computational methods, software tools, and technical concepts.

Additional Qualifications, At The SES.2 Level

Comprehensive knowledge of computational and data-science concepts, demonstrating full competency.
Relevant previous experience and demonstrated ability to perform independent work, including automating manual scientific, engineering, laboratory, or business processes.
Broad application of technical principles, theories, concepts, and techniques in an applicable scientific or engineering discipline, in addition to working knowledge of other related fields, such as software-development practices (version control, testing, code review, documentation, and continuous integration).
Experience establishing and maintaining procedures for computational, software, or data-analysis capabilities, and recommending process improvements as appropriate.
Proficient verbal and written communication skills necessary to effectively collaborate in a team environment and present and explain technical information, including preparing technical reports, publications, presentations, or software documentation.
Demonstrated ability to independently learn and apply new computational methods, software tools, and technical concepts, and to establish effective working relationships with multidisciplinary teams.

Qualifications We Desire

Master of Science degree in computer science, data science, computational science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Demonstrated experience automating manual scientific, engineering, laboratory, or business processes.
Experience designing, training, validating, deploying, and maintaining machine-learning models, including deep learning, neural networks, time-series analysis, computer vision, image processing, or natural-language processing.
Experience developing machine-vision systems or image-analysis algorithms.
Experience integrating software with laboratory instruments, sensors, robotic systems, or engineering tools.
Experience developing standard operating procedures, laboratory work instructions, computational workflows, software documentation, or data-management plans.
Experience with cloud computing, high-performance computing, containerization, or distributed data processing.
Experience with uncertainty quantification, experimental design, statistical modeling, or physics-informed machine learning, and ability to assess model performance, interpretability, robustness, generalizability, and operational limitations.
Experience with database design, SQL optimization, data warehousing, data lakes, or scientific data repositories; developing data pipelines, application programming interfaces, dashboards, or user-facing analytical tools; and a record of publications, patents, presentations, software products, or other technical contributions in computational science, data science, machine learning, automation, or a related field.

Pay Range

$121,830 - $185,544 Annually

$121,830 - $154,500 Annually for the SES.1 level

$146,340 - $185,544 Annually for the SES.2 level

This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting; pay will not be below any applicable local minimum wage. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Additional Information

Position Information

This is a Career Indefinite position, open to Lab employees and external candidates.

Why Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory?

Included in 2026 Best Places to Work by Glassdoor!
Flexible Benefits Package
401(k)

Our values - visit https://www.llnl.gov/inclusion/our-values

This position requires a Department of Energy (DOE) Q-level clearance. If you are selected, we will initiate a Federal background investigation to determine if you meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information or matter. Also, all L or Q cleared employees are subject to random drug testing. Q-level clearance requires U.S. citizenship.

Pre-Employment Drug Test

External applicant(s) selected for this position must pass a post-offer, pre-employment drug test. This includes testing for use of marijuana as Federal Law applies to us as a Federal Contractor.

Per the Department of Energy (DOE), Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory must meet certain restrictions with the use and/or possession of mobile devices in Limited Areas. Depending on your job duties, you may be required to work in a Limited Area where you are not permitted to have a personal and/or laboratory mobile device in your possession. This includes, but not limited to cell phones, tablets, fitness devices, wireless headphones, and other Bluetooth/wireless enabled devices.

If you use a medical device, which pairs with a mobile device, you must still follow the rules concerning the mobile device in individual sections within Limited Areas. Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities require separate approval. Hearing aids without wireless capabilities or wireless that has been disabled are allowed in Limited Areas, Secure Space and Transit/Buffer Space within buildings.

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD102308

Position Overview

Autodesk is seeking an experienced, forward-thinking Preconstruction Subject Matter Expert (SME) to accelerate the expansion and commercial success of Autodesk Forma Preconstruction solutions across the construction industry.

As a member of Autodesk’s Technical Sales organization, you will leverage deep expertise in preconstruction workflows—including estimating, quantity takeoff, bid management, subcontractor qualification, procurement planning, budgeting, and cost forecasting—to serve as a trusted advisor to prospective and existing customers, helping them modernize processes, optimize operations, and achieve measurable business outcomes.

Through executive engagement, industry thought leadership, and a deep understanding of customer technology ecosystems, you will help position Autodesk as a strategic partner in transforming preconstruction operations. Success in this role is measured by commercial impact and customer expansion, including revenue influence, opportunity development, and measurable improvements in preconstruction workflows and business outcomes.

We are open to remote candidates based in the United States and Canada.

Identify customer challenges, business priorities, and opportunities to expand Autodesk Forma Preconstruction capabilities across estimating, quantity takeoff, bidding, subcontractor qualification, procurement, and related workflow
Guide customers through workflow discovery, process assessments, solution evaluations, and proof-of-value engagements to demonstrate measurable business outcomes
Help customers modernize disconnected processes and expand connected digital workflows across preconstruction teams, business units, and downstream construction operations
Partner with Customer Success and account teams to accelerate time to value, support sustained expansion, and maximize the impact of Autodesk technology investments
Discover, assess, and document customer technology ecosystems, including estimating, takeoff, bid management, subcontractor qualification, ERP, procurement, and related systems and integrations
Identify customer technology initiatives, operational challenges, and opportunities to connect systems, automate processes, and modernize preconstruction workflows
Collaborate with customers to identify how Autodesk Forma Preconstruction solutions, automation, and emerging AI capabilities can improve productivity, decision-making, and operational efficiency
Document customer technology landscapes, strategic priorities, and identified opportunities to inform account planning, technical sales strategies, and future expansion
Demonstrate deep expertise across the preconstruction lifecycle, including conceptual and detailed estimating, quantity takeoff, bid solicitation and leveling, subcontractor qualification, procurement planning, budgeting, cost forecasting, and risk management
Advise customers on preconstruction best practices, operational strategies, project delivery methods, and opportunities to modernize workflows through Autodesk Forma Preconstruction solutions
Help customers connect technology investments to measurable improvements in estimating accuracy, bid competitiveness, subcontractor selection, cost predictability, and project profitability
Stay on the forefront of emerging construction technologies, competitive solutions, and evolving preconstruction industry trends
Lead strategic customer discovery sessions, workflow workshops, executive briefings, and proof-of-value engagements that align Autodesk Forma Preconstruction capabilities with customer business priorities
Develop and deliver customer-specific demonstration scenarios highlighting connected estimating, takeoff, bidding, subcontractor qualification, and cost management workflows

Capture and communicate customer feedback, workflow challenges, competitive insights, and emerging preconstruction technology requirements to Product Management and Engineering
Identify high-value preconstruction use cases and support customer validation of new capabilities to inform future product development and innovation
Represent Autodesk at industry conferences, customer events, webinars, executive forums, and industry associations to share expertise and strengthen industry relationships
Contribute to Autodesk’s position as a trusted leader in connected preconstruction technology and construction industry innovation
Partner with sales teams to identify, qualify, and advance strategic preconstruction opportunities across new and existing customers
Develop compelling value propositions that connect Autodesk Forma Preconstruction solutions to customer priorities, operational efficiency, risk reduction, and business growth
Support strategic sales engagements, executive presentations, solution evaluations, and competitive positioning to influence purchasing decisions and strengthen technical win strategies
Contribute to regional sales objectives through measurable preconstruction-influenced pipeline, opportunity progression, and revenue

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of construction industry experience, including significant hands-on or leadership experience in preconstruction, estimating, bidding, procurement, or related disciplines
Deep understanding of commercial construction preconstruction processes, including conceptual and detailed estimating, quantity takeoff, bid management, subcontractor qualification, procurement planning, budgeting, cost forecasting, and risk management
Strong knowledge of project delivery methods, contract structures, construction economics, and the operational and financial factors influencing preconstruction decisions
Demonstrated experience leveraging construction technology to modernize preconstruction workflows, improve operational efficiency, and deliver measurable business outcomes
Ability to engage confidently with construction executives, preconstruction leaders, estimators, and technology stakeholders, translating industry challenges and technical solutions into compelling business value
Passion for emerging construction technologies, continuous learning, and helping construction organizations embrace new ways of working
The ability to travel up to 45%

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated success leading preconstruction process improvement initiatives, technology evaluations, digital transformation programs, or enterprise workflow modernization efforts
Experience quantifying the business impact and ROI of preconstruction technology investments
Experience leveraging emerging technologies, including AI and intelligent automation, to improve estimating, takeoff, bidding, subcontractor qualification, or other preconstruction workflows

Experience speaking at industry conferences, customer events, executive forums, or professional associations
Prior people leadership or team management experience
Experience influencing technology purchasing decisions or collaborating with sales and commercial teams
Experience with Autodesk Forma, Forma Takeoff, Forma Estimate, BuildingConnected, TradeTapp, or comparable preconstruction technology platforms
Experience in technical sales, solutions engineering, solution consulting, or customer-facing technology advisory roles

The ideal candidate is a seasoned construction industry professional with deep preconstruction expertise and a proven track record of improving how construction organizations plan, estimate, pursue, and win work. They combine hands-on preconstruction experience with a passion for technology and innovation, helping customers modernize workflows, improve operational efficiency, and achieve measurable business outcomes. jobs.title: (CW) Laboratory Research Associate II / , Assay Strategy and Development
jobs.description:
Who We Are

BioMarin is a leading rare disease biotechnology company focused on genetically defined conditions.

Guided by our purpose to develop medicines that make a profound impact on people’s lives, our global teams have delivered a portfolio of therapies since our founding in 1997. Our revolutionary treatments for conditions like achondroplasia (the most common form of dwarfism), PKU (phenylketonuria), CLN2, a form of Batten disease, and a number of forms of MPS (mucopolysaccharidosis) offer new possibilities for patients and families who previously had few, if any, available options. More recently, with the close of the Amicus acquisition, our portfolio has expanded to include therapies for Fabry disease and Pompe disease, expanding our ability to reach more people living with rare genetic conditions.

Our success comes from our unwavering commitment to excellence, our deep understanding of patient needs, our scientific expertise, and our world-class manufacturing capabilities. At the heart of BioMarin is a dedicated team of the brightest minds in the industry working together to deliver innovative therapies to patients and families around the world.

About Worldwide Research And Development

From research and discovery to post-market clinical development, our R&D engine involves all bench and clinical research and the associated groups that support those endeavors. Our teams work on developing first-in-class and best-in-class therapeutics that provide meaningful advances to patients who live with rare diseases.

CONTRACT : : Research Associate 2, Assay Strategy and Development

ROLE: Laboratory Research Associate

The Assay Strategy and Development group within the BAS Translational Sciences (TS) group generates bioanalytical data to enable the non-clinical and clinical development of therapeutics. The team is responsible for establishing a program assay strategy, developing, characterizing and validating assays, applying a variety of platforms and evaluating novel technologies, and conducting translational research internally, at the BioMarin Research Center as well as externally with partner contract research organizations (CROs). BAS investigates planned and emerging scientific questions in TS that can be experimentally addressed and may involve application of new technology and/or use of exploratory data sets to support program development and strategy.

The Research Associate 2/ Senior Research Associate (SRA) is a laboratory-based role. With oversight from Senior Scientists an RA/SRA is responsible for performing the development, optimization, and validation of assays. RAs test or oversee the testing of non-clinical and clinical samples to enable the development of therapeutic programs. This role conducts laboratory experimentation based on literature protocols and standard operating procedures (SOPs) and shares general laboratory maintenance responsibilities. They may work with CROs or academic collaborators to achieve scientific objectives. All experiments and methods used, raw data, and data analyses are appropriately documented, and results are effectively communicated at team meetings.

Detailed Responsibilities

Assay Planning, Design, and Development

Lead the development and validation of bioanalytical methods to support pharmacokinetic, pharmacodynamic, biomarkers, and immunogenicity assessments and apply appropriate scientific methods to address experimental questions. Techniques may include (but are not limited to) ELISA/ECL, ligand binding assays, polymerase chain reaction (PCR, qPCR, and ddPCR), various Next-generation sequencing (NGS) platforms, cell-based and ex vivo culture assays, enzyme activity assays, surface plasma resonance, cytometry, nucleic acid extraction, ultrasensitive protein, mass spectrometry or oligonucleotide assays
Collaborate with lead scientists and project team members to contribute to assay planning efforts
Evaluate existing assays and technology and identify opportunities for improvement
Review relevant literature and make suggestions for application or troubleshooting
Develop new techniques or bring in new technologies to enhance the group’s analytical capabilities
Apply appropriate scientific methods to address important TS scientific questions that can be experimentally addressed

Laboratory Execution and Documentation

Design and conduct laboratory experiments to develop, optimize, characterize, and validate assays and provide decisive data packages
Write and execute procedures and protocols (e.g., SOPs) and note where changes need to be made, as applicable
Perform experiments for assigned program(s) utilizing standard scientific equipment, tools, and techniques (e.g., microscopy, ELISA, PCR, LC-MS, cell culture, etc.); suggest opportunities for adopting or using new / emerging equipment, tools and techniques
Work on a wide range of processes and suggest any opportunities to adapt existing processes
Oversee proper use and maintenance of laboratory equipment
May monitor vendors to develop assays
May support equipment maintenance
Maintain an inspection-ready laboratory
Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of experimental assays, experimental procedures, observations, data, data analysis and conclusions in electronic laboratory notebooks (ELN) and databases
Adhere to laboratory safety protocols, ethical guidelines, and regulatory requirements

Analysis & Presentation of Results

Conduct, or contribute to the conduct of, the analysis and interpretation of results and assay troubleshooting
Utilize statistical analyses to demonstrate assay performance, demonstrate testing proficiency and interpret the resulting data
Suggest ideas for the design/development of new experiments and/or assays based on analysis and interpretation
Communicate results through documentation in lab notebooks and presentations and may contribute to the preparation of research reports, study reports, manuscripts, regulatory documents (e.g., IND submissions), publications and presentations to communicate research findings to internal teams, health authorities and external scientific audiences

Scientific Leadership

Develop subject matter expertise in a platform or technology and contribute to the broader scientific community
Support and/or participate in collaborations with experts in the broader scientific community and contribute to the development of relevant thought leadership content – publications, manuscripts, procedures, patents, and speaking engagements

Functional / Cross-Functional Participation and Leadership

May participate in laboratory safety and process improvement initiatives within BAS, TS, and across RED
May collaborate with other RED laboratories (e.g., Center of Technology, CoTe) to achieve assay and project objectives

Note: This description is not intended to be all-inclusive, or a limitation of the duties of the position. It is intended to describe the general nature of the job that may include other duties as assumed or assigned.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Job Description

The Genomics Core is looking for a Biomedical Technician to join the team!

The Genomics Core is a fully equipped, state-of-the-art genomics facility offering data generation and interpretation for basic science and translational research in next-generation sequencing technologies, including single cell omics, spatial transcriptomics, and bulk cell omics. We specialize in single cell omics and spatial transcriptomics via the 10x Genomics, Parse Biosciences, Mission Bio, and NanoString platforms. Our R&D team offers sample preparation for single cell assays, such as nuclei isolation from frozen tissue or single cell isolation from fresh tissue dissociation. The AGCT Core also offers comprehensive services for standard bulk cell sequencing in genomics, transcriptomics, epigenomics, and metagenomics. To learn more please visit Applied Genomics, Computation & Translational Core | Cedars-Sinai.

Are you ready to be a part of breakthrough research?

The Genomics Core Biomedical Technician participates in wet- and dry- laboratory projects and may execute tasks requiring compliance with all Federal and State accrediting agency requirements and/or Good Laboratory Practices (GLP). Responsible for assigned wet lab work, lab maintenance, and writing and recording controlled documents. Performs all activities strictly according to SOPs, with accurate documentation, and may assist quality control team with required activities. Installs and maintains laboratory equipment to ensure proper functioning of devices. Assists in addressing complex issues and troubleshooting.

Consult with technical support on library preparation or sequencing run performance issues.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Dr. Marilyn Ader
i s seeking a Research Associate II to join the team!

The overall focus of the lab of Marilyn Ader, PhD, is the pathogenesis of Type 2 diabetes, with an integrative perspective on the impact of obesity on insulin sensitivity, insulin secretion and hepatic insulin clearance. She examines the mechanisms by which multiple organ systems interact to maintain glucose homeostasis in the face of environmental and pharmacologic insults. One of her primary projects investigates mechanisms by which antipsychotic drugs induce obesity and glucose dysregulation. These studies have had major translational and public health impact, and they involve both large-animal studies and collaborative work of psychiatric patients. Ader is a leading expert in the role of insulin-independent factors, termed "glucose effectiveness," in glucose homeostasis, and has published extensively in this area in peer-reviewed papers, book chapters and reviews. Ader also examines the role of insulin clearance in determining insulin sensitivity and fasting insulin levels, and studies the impact of obesity on the contribution of liver clearance versus pancreatic beta-cell insulin secretion to fasting hyperinsulinemia. Ader is also pursuing novel pancreatic islet transplant research for possible clinical treatment of Type 1 diabetes.

Are you ready to be a part of breakthrough research

Working under direct supervision, the Research Associate II performs routine and increasingly complex laboratory tasks and procedures and develops technical expertise in one or more areas relevant to research projects. The Research Associate II will participate in research activities involving all aspects of the research process, to include, but not limited to; investigation, technical, testing/validation of results, and report findings. The Associate will perform a variety of routine experimental protocols and procedures to support the objectives of laboratory research projects. The Associate will observe and comply with safety standards and procedures, assist in preparation of data for publication and/or presentation at scholarly meetings, and assist in general laboratory maintenance. This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.

Founded in 1965, UC Irvine
is a member of the prestigious Association of American Universities and is ranked among the nation’s top 10 public universities by U.S. News & World Report. It’s located in one of the world’s safest and most economically vibrant communities and is Orange County’s second-largest employer, contributing $7 billion annually to the local economy and $8 billion statewide.

To learn more about UC Irvine, visit www.uci.edu.

Our lab is based in both the UCI School of Medicine and its Department of Emergency Medicine. Our work bridges together researchers from across the U.S. as well as across University of California campuses to study traffic and transportation safety, motor vehicle driver behavior, socioecological factors that influence safe/risky driving behaviors, and related prevention policy. While our work is focused on traffic and road safety, most of our day-to-day work is focused on individual/population health, medicine, and primary as well as secondary prevention of motor vehicle crash injury.

UCI's Department of Emergency Medicine is committed to advancing clinical care, education and research to help patients with diverse emergency conditions. We offer patient-centered care, apply cutting edge skills to combat serious illness and injury. In addition, our physicians conduct innovative research aimed at preventing injury and disease.

Your Role on the Team

Under the direction of the Principal Investigator, the Staff Research Associate (SRA) will be responsible for day-to-day operations of assigned data analysis for research projects and writing briefs and manuscripts related to research. The candidate will need to have experience of epidemiology and data science using statistical and analytical techniques/computer science and can ensure timelines are met. The person will conduct statistical analyses on the current and future research projects, and write up the research results into manuscripts, briefs, and grant applications. The candidate will work with lab staff and students to further the research goals of the lab.

The ideal candidate will be extremely motivated, highly organized, and highly detail oriented. Must have a minimum of a bachelor’s degree and greater than 3 years of epidemiology and data science research and/or work experience. Demonstrated knowledge and skill in current and emerging biostatistical and data science analytical techniques.

To successfully address these tasks on time, the SRA must have a broad set of intelligence, be extremely diligent and task-oriented, and an efficient worker. Excellent communication and writing skills are required.

The SRA will be supervised by the Principal Investigator, with the ultimate goal of progressive independence once the SRA has demonstrated the ability to carry out the PI and project related plans.

Required

Proficiency in hypothesis testing, including no mistakes in use of t-tests, regressions, ANOVA, mixed effects modeling, chi-square, and other common tests.

Position Title:
Senior Manager, Data Science

Department:
Clinical Data Sciences & Analytics

Reports To:
Head of Clinical Data Analytics

Location:
South San Francisco, CA or Princeton, NJ – On-site 4 days per week (Mon to Thurs)

Job Overview

The Senior Manager of Data Science is a hands-on role at the intersection of Data Science, Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, and Clinical Data Management. The ideal candidate combines strong programming and technical development skills with an understanding of clinical studies and the ability to build practical solutions that improve how teams access, analyze, visualize, and work with clinical data.

This position will support ongoing studies while also helping build the technical infrastructure, automation, and reusable tools that enable a growing Biometrics organization to work more efficiently. Additionally, this position will play an important role in establishing modern development standards (version control, code review, testing, and automation) and modernizing clinical analytics with open-source tools.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Key Project Responsibilities:

Develop data science solutions and analytical tools to support clinical studies and broader Biometrics initiatives.
Design and build dashboards and interactive data visualizations (e.g., R Shiny) that enable effective clinical data review and decision-making.
Work with databases and clinical data sources to support data integration, access, analysis, and visualization.
Build and maintain automated workflows using GitHub and GitHub Actions, including automated quality checks, testing, code review, and deployment workflows for analytical applications and tools.
Partner closely with Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, Data Management, and other cross-functional stakeholders to understand study needs and develop effective technical solutions.
Apply R and SAS to clinical data and analytical challenges, selecting the appropriate technology for each use case, and use Python when it provides the most effective solution.
Develop reusable tools, R packages, workflows, and infrastructure that can be leveraged by Statistical Programming, Biostatistics, Data Management, and other team members.

Initiative Responsibilities

Under the guidance of the Head of Clinical Data Analytics, identify opportunities to automate manual processes and introduce innovative technologies and more efficient ways of working.
Establish and promote effective Git/GitHub workflows, version control, and collaborative development practices, and mentor less experienced team members in adopting modern programming, automation, and application development practices.

Education

Qualifications and Preferred Skills

Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics/Biostatistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.

Experience And Skill Set

Minimum of 6 years of experience in data science, statistical programming, or clinical analytics in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO clinical trial environment.
